نتساءل (form VI)
# نَتَسَاءَلُ (natasāʔalu) /na.ta.saː.ʔa.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَسَاءَلَ (tasāʔala)
# نَتَسَاءَلَ (natasāʔala) /na.ta.saː.ʔa.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَسَاءَلَ (tasāʔala)
# نَتَسَاءَلْ (natasāʔal) /na.ta.saː.ʔal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَسَاءَلَ (tasāʔala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
